findings.what: The frozen baseline records `probe | production | clean | no failed requests`. Re-running probe.cjs today against BOTH pat (new release) and production (OLD release 0096a476) gives 6 identical net::ERR_ABORTED failures — relative-path asset requests under /board/<id>/ (katomia.css, kflow.js, katomia-init.js, katomia-core.js, katomia-localdb.js, katomia-board.css).
findings.conclusion: Production on the PREVIOUS release reproduces it exactly, so this is pre-existing and NOT caused by TXSTATUS-CONSOLIDATE1. What it does show is that the frozen baseline's 'probe clean' line is not reproducible as written — the exact command/URL was never recorded alongside the verdict, so it cannot be established what was actually measured.
findings.lesson: A benchmark entry must record the command that produced it, not just the verdict. Same class of gap as test ids that resolve to nothing.
findings.followup: Worth its own look: whether those aborted relative-path requests are benign (cancelled by a clean-URL redirect — the board does load and sign successfully on both targets) or a real waste on every board load.

findings.what: Looked like 'ERROR, 2 consecutive non-passes'. It was NOT failing: a failed run on 08-07 left its own unanswered pairing proposal in kwallet-mainnet, and the cron's 'skip if any pending item' guard then muted the test entirely. The grid said non-passes; the truth was 'not run since'.
findings.followup: Fixed: all four cron guards now age pending items (only <30m blocks). Re-ran: PASS, real mainnet transfer, consensus 1786177210.454269104. Two older reds were harness flakes (boardPlayerModal pointer-intercept; #addAcctJoinAll landing race) — QA-HARNESSREPAIR1.

findings.severity: RESOLVED 2026-08-08 — and it was hiding a real product bug
findings.what: Reported SILENT. Root cause was not a flaky pairing step: window.WC.ensureNetwork() after a resetWalletLink()+reload NEVER SETTLES (no resolve, no reject, no error), and the harness had no step ceiling, so the cron's outer timeout killed it and it reported nothing for 14 days.
findings.followup: Harness fixed (ceilings; the redundant reset removed from the main flow — chromium.launch already gives a clean profile — and re-expressed as isolated assertion A5.0). Now 8/9 on lab1 AND pat, with A5.1-A5.8 green. The single red A5.0 is a genuine product defect: WC-RESETWEDGE1.
